operations.description: do-while loop iterating exactly 64 times using a countdown counter seeded to 64.
Each iteration calls the field-initializer helper F_3FieldInitCall on the current 9-dword sub-structure pointer.
Advance the sub-structure pointer by 9 dwords per iteration before the next call.
After the loop, call the same field-initializer helper once more on this + 576 dwords.
Zero this[585] (byte offset 0x924), the first of the five trailing mixer fields.
